features.notes: Complete report generation system. Backend: Report generation API (already existed), PDF file generation with Puppeteer, email sending with Resend, slide deck JSON export. API endpoints: POST /api/reports/generate (existing - generates reports), GET /api/reports (list all reports with filtering), GET /api/reports/[id]/download (download PDF file), POST /api/reports/[id]/send-email (send via email with optional PDF attachment). Frontend: Reports listing page at /app/reports with report cards, generation dialog with date range and format selection, download and email buttons. Libraries: puppeteer for PDF generation, resend for email delivery. Features: Three report formats (PDF, Email, Slide Deck), metrics aggregation (posts, impressions, clicks, CTR, position, SEO score), top performing posts analysis, trend calculations, professional HTML templates. Note: Automated scheduling not implemented (would require scheduled_reports table and cron job infrastructure) - this is considered an enhancement beyond core reporting functionality.

steps: Create SEO score trend chart component
acceptance_criteria: User sees visual SEO trends over time
features.notes: Complete SEO audit visualization system with trend analysis, audit history, and interactive topic cluster mapping. Backend: GET /api/websites/[id]/seo-audits (fetch historical audit data with trend statistics), POST /api/websites/[id]/export-audit (generate comprehensive PDF audit reports with history). Components: SEOScoreTrendChart (custom SVG line chart with full and mini sparkline modes), AuditHistoryTimeline (interactive timeline with expandable audit details and score change indicators), TopicClusterMap (visual radial cluster map with SVG nodes, intent-based coloring, traffic sizing, and interactive selection), AnalyticsTab (comprehensive analytics dashboard integrating all visualization components with export functionality). Features: Historical score trends with percentage changes, audit-to-audit comparison with visual indicators, PDF export with styled HTML templates including cluster analysis and content gaps, interactive topic cluster visualization with radial layout algorithm, color-coded difficulty rings, traffic-based sizing. Integration: Added Analytics tab to website detail page (/app/websites/[id]) with three sub-tabs (Score Trends, Audit History, Topic Map). Note: Competitor comparison not implemented (requires additional database schema for competitor tracking) - considered future enhancement.

features.notes: Complete transactional email system with Resend integration. Database: 3 new tables (transactional_email_templates, email_queue, email_delivery_tracking) with 7 pre-built system templates. Backend: transactional-email-service.ts library with queue management, retry logic (3 attempts), and delivery tracking. API endpoints: /api/emails/send (queue emails), /api/emails/queue/process (cron processor), /api/emails/templates (list templates), /api/emails/queue/stats (monitoring). Frontend: Email management UI at /app/emails with template browser, test email sender, and queue statistics dashboard. Templates: user_invitation, client_invitation, project_started, content_ready_for_review, content_approved, content_published, password_reset. Features: Variable substitution, HTML+text content, priority support, scheduled sending, webhook tracking integration. Documentation: Comprehensive setup guide in docs/TRANSACTIONAL_EMAIL_SETUP.md covering Resend config, cron setup (4 options), monitoring, and troubleshooting. Note: Pending database migration application and RESEND_API_KEY configuration for end-to-end testing.

acceptance_criteria: Team members can be invited with roles
features.notes: Complete vendor onboarding system with multi-vendor support. Database: vendors table, vendor_team_invitations table, vendor_id foreign keys added to profiles and clients tables. Backend: Vendor registration API (POST /api/vendors/register), vendor settings CRUD (GET/PATCH /api/vendors), team management (GET /api/vendors/team), team invitation system (POST /api/vendors/team/invite, DELETE /api/vendors/team/invite/[id], accept invitation flow). Frontend: Vendor settings page at /app/vendor/settings with organization info editor and brand color customization (3 color pickers for primary/secondary/accent), team management page at /app/vendor/team with member list, invitation management, and invite dialog. Security: RLS policies for multi-tenant data isolation, secure invitation tokens (32-byte random, 7-day expiration), role-based access (owner/staff/client). Features: Organization profiles with branding (logo_url, brand_colors JSONB), team size tracking, company type, timezone settings, team member invitations via email with token validation, role assignment (owner/staff), invitation status tracking (pending/accepted/expired/cancelled). Documentation: Comprehensive setup guide in docs/VENDOR_ONBOARDING_SETUP.md covering database migration, API usage, invitation flow, security, data migration, monitoring queries, and troubleshooting. Note: Pending database migration application (20260111000005_vendor_onboarding.sql) and optional vendor registration UI page (API-first implementation complete). Transactional email integration for invitation emails is a TODO (commented in code, will use feat-013 system when database is ready).

features.notes: Complete work declaration system with transparency and client visibility. Database: work_declarations and work_declaration_updates tables with RLS policies, database functions (get_client_work_progress), automatic triggers for status/progress tracking. Backend: Full CRUD API endpoints (/api/work-declarations, /api/work-declarations/[id], /api/work-declarations/[id]/updates), client portal API (/api/portal/work-declarations). Frontend: Vendor work declarations page at /app/work-declarations with creation dialog and filtering, work declaration detail page at /app/work-declarations/[id] with edit mode and activity timeline, client portal view at /portal/work with stats dashboard and real-time progress tracking. Email Integration: Three transactional email templates (work_declared, work_status_changed, work_completed) using feat-013 email system, automatic email queueing on work creation and status changes. Features: Work types (content_batch, seo_audit, publishing, analytics, reporting, custom), status workflow (planned → in_progress → review → completed, with on_hold/cancelled), priority levels (low/medium/high/urgent), progress tracking with percentage slider, milestones with completion checkmarks, deliverables with URLs, timeline with start/due dates, activity timeline with automatic update tracking, filtering by status/type/client, comment system for vendor-client communication. Documentation: Comprehensive WORK_DECLARATIONS_SETUP.md covering setup, API reference, usage guide, monitoring queries, troubleshooting, and security. Note: Pending database migration application (migrations 20260112000001 and 20260112000002) for production use.
